headline: Verstappen wins at Sepang, Singapore next. UFC Vegas this Saturday, and a monster October for games.

upcoming.what: UFC Fight Night: Allen vs Duncan — Apex, Las Vegas (main card 01:00 Sun Irish time)
Valor Mortis and Planet Zoo 2 release
GT World Challenge Europe Endurance Cup finale — 3 Hours of Portimão
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 releases
Orionid meteor shower peaks — look east after midnight

items.headline: Verstappen wins the Bahrain GP — held at Sepang
items.summary: The relocated Bahrain Grand Prix ran at Malaysia's Sepang circuit on Sunday after the April date was postponed. Verstappen took the win from Antonelli, with Hamilton third and Leclerc fourth.

items.headline: Russell took Baku before that
items.summary: Russell converted pole into victory in Azerbaijan, holding off Verstappen by two tenths, while Antonelli charged from 16th to fifth.

items.headline: Singapore up next, with a sprint this year
items.summary: F1 heads to Marina Bay on 11 October; the 2026 event adds a sprint race to the weekend.

items.headline: GTWC Endurance: Mercedes Mann-Filter lead into Portimão finale
items.summary: Auer, Engel and Stolz hold a big Pro Cup lead heading to the 3 Hours of Portimão (17–18 Oct). AF Corse's #51 Ferrari of Mosca, Nielsen and Rovera won this year's 24 Hours of Spa.

items.headline: UFC Vegas this Saturday: Allen vs Duncan
items.summary: Brendan Allen meets England's Christian Leroy Duncan in a five-round middleweight main event. Co-main has Jai Herbert against Matheus Camilo; Godinez vs Souza and Fili vs Kamaka also on the main card.

items.headline: Big fights on the horizon
items.summary: Chatter this week around Volkanovski vs Evloev, Pereira vs Pavlovich, and Oliveira vs Diego Lopes, which Eddie Alvarez calls a BMF-calibre fight. Kevin Vallejos is preparing for Aljamain Sterling.

items.headline: O'Malley eyes Petr Yan route
items.summary: O'Malley says he may skip Payton Talbott and target Yan if Merab Dvalishvili loses. Elsewhere, Sean Sharaf is still riding his upset win over Gable Steveson at UFC 331.

items.headline: ADCC 2026 recap: Pena makes absolute history
items.summary: Felipe Pena became the first two-time ADCC absolute champion in Kraków, choking Roosevelt Sousa in the final. Luke Griffith submitted defending champ Kaynan Duarte to take -99kg.

items.headline: Crevar and Jaworski win ADCC gold
items.summary: ONE Championship grapplers Helena Crevar and Paweł Jaworski both left Kraków as world champions — a home win for Jaworski.

items.headline: Witcher 3 Remastered breaks its own Steam record
items.summary: The free remaster (out 29 Sept) peaked at about 121k concurrent players on Steam, the game's best ever. AMD users hit graphical corruption, fixed by the Adrenalin 26.9.2 driver, and Switch 2 handheld looks soft for some players.

items.headline: Witcher 4 aiming for 2028; Witcher 3 gets a third expansion
items.summary: CDPR's latest update has 500+ devs on Witcher 4 with Ciri leading and Kovir among the regions, targeting 2028. Witcher 3's new expansion, Songs of the Past, lands in 2027 with a new region, Letten. Nothing new on Cyberpunk 2 this week.

items.headline: Borderlands 4: FL4K story pack is the latest drop
items.summary: Story Pack 2, FL4K and the Last Resort, arrived 10 Sept alongside new Vault Hunter Loveless the Hacker and Bounty Pack 5. Gearbox hasn't detailed what comes next yet.

items.headline: Star Wars: Galactic Racer is out today
items.summary: A run-based Star Wars racer lands on Steam today, kicking off a packed month.

items.headline: This week: Dragon's Dogma 2 expansion, Car Park Capital
items.summary: Dark Arisen for Dragon's Dogma 2 and the car-culture city builder Car Park Capital both arrive 9 October. Valor Mortis (Napoleonic soulslike) and Planet Zoo 2 follow on the 13th, with Enshrouded hitting 1.0 on the 15th.

items.headline: Later in October: CoD MW4 and Phantom Blade Zero
items.summary: Final Fantasy Resonance (22nd), Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 (23rd) and Phantom Blade Zero (28th) round out the month.

items.headline: OpenAI to watermark ChatGPT text in the EU
items.summary: OpenAI is starting to mark ChatGPT-generated text for users in Europe.

items.headline: Reflection launches Beam, an open-weight model
items.summary: Reflection's new open-weight model is pitched as a cost-efficient Western rival to the leading Chinese open models.

items.headline: AI chip startup Etched draws $40B+ offers
items.summary: The transformer-ASIC maker is fielding funding offers at a valuation above $40 billion.

items.headline: TikTok adds an AI shopping assistant
items.summary: TikTok is rolling out AI shopping help and one-click checkout inside the app.

items.headline: Crew-13 is on its way to the ISS
items.summary: SpaceX launched NASA's Crew-13 mission to the International Space Station, with some striking infrared shots of the climb to orbit.

items.headline: A second-generation planet around a dead star
items.summary: Astronomers found a rare planet that appears to have formed from the leftovers around a white dwarf, after the original star died.

items.headline: Altermagnetism could mean faster, leaner chips
items.summary: Researchers found a new type of magnetism in tunable materials that could lead to faster, more energy-efficient spin-based electronics.

items.headline: Sky this month: Saturn and the Orionids
items.summary: Saturn is at its brightest around opposition, and the Orionid meteors (debris from Halley's Comet) peak later in October. Clear skies over Cavan permitting.
